scripts.setup: pnpm install && npm --prefix packages/tilawa-core install && npm --prefix web/frontend install && npm run build:core && npm run ensure:assets
scripts.assets:download: cd web/frontend && node scripts/prepare-v1-assets.mjs --models-url https://tilawa.dev/v1/ && mkdir -p .v1_cache && cp -r dist/v1/* .v1_cache/
scripts.assets:restore: [ -d web/frontend/.v1_cache ] && mkdir -p web/frontend/dist/v1 && cp -r web/frontend/.v1_cache/* web/frontend/dist/v1/ || true
scripts.ensure:assets: [ -f web/frontend/dist/v1/manifest.json ] || ([ -f web/frontend/.v1_cache/manifest.json ] && npm run assets:restore) || npm run assets:download
scripts.build:front: npm --prefix web/frontend run build && npm run ensure:assets
scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && pnpm -r build && npm run build:front && npm run build:server
scripts.start:front: [ -d packages/tilawa-core/dist ] || npm run build:core; npm run ensure:assets; npm --prefix web/frontend run dev
scripts.start:server: npm run ensure:assets; npm --prefix web/frontend run start
scripts.start:all: npm run build:core && npm run build:front && npm run build:server && npm run start:server
